conviction_note: Evidence is two-sided and mostly public: a direct customer (Microsoft) said third-party capacity due in the Jul-Sep quarter slipped, which is the exact failure that produced the Nov-2025 guide cut and -16%, while CoreWeave's own landlords (Core Scientific +90 MW billed q/q, Applied Digital RFS) show its capacity ramp continued; against a -38.6% 20-day drawdown, 21% of float short and a +14 vol-point put skew, p_up sits near 50 (49) on an abs move of 17, so the scaled number (-0.34) and the finding sum (+0.6) are both near zero and differ in sign only because the positioning finding is sized on its own while p_up also carries the put skew and a 1-of-4 up reaction record.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue consensus $3.52-3.54B (Earnings Whispers $3.54B / $3.52B, Benzinga $3.54B, Zacks ~$3.5B, risen from ~$3.30B when guided) against company guide $3.45-3.60B (midpoint $3.525B); non-GAAP EPS consensus -$1.17 (Zacks/EW; Benzinga -$1.49, whisper -$1.00, so EPS bar disputed); company guide Q3 adj. operating income $200-260M, Q3 interest expense $860-940M; FY2026 revenue $12.4-13.2B, FY adj. OI ~$960M-1.15/1.18B, capex $35-39B, exit-2026 run-rate $18.5-19.5B, >1.85 GW active power by YE (1.5 GW at June), Q4 low-teens adj. op margin target. Sources: https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/CRWV/22731 , https://finviz.com/news/414429/coreweaves-margin-inflection-faces-its-first-test-as-shares-sit-near-post-earnings-lows , https://siliconangle.com/2026/08/11/coreweave-coasts-solid-earnings-beat-sending-stock-higher-hours/ . Revenue bar sourced to a company guide plus agreeing estimates; EPS bar disputed across providers.
positioning_check: Short interest 69,779,354 shares = 21.25% of float (Nasdaq settlement, latest listed 2026-10-15, published 2026-10-26), days to cover 0.97 because turnover is ~70M shares/day (https://fintel.io/ss/us/crwv, read 2026-11-10); July 2026 settlements ~61-64M shares, ~20% of float, 2.0-2.3 DTC. FINRA off-exchange short volume ratio 38-41% on 2026-11-02/04. Crowded by % of float, not by days to cover. Baseline: skew_25d +14.29 vol points (downside paid), put/call OI 0.88, event-implied move 16.08% (straddle 18.21%), ATM IV 218%, spot $47.78, -11.1% 5d, -38.6% 20d, -65.4% from 52w high, +9.4% off 52w low. Last four prints: +19.28, -11.40, -18.51, -16.31 (1 up of 4).

findings.finding: Microsoft CFO Amy Hood on the 2026-10-28 FQ1 call (Jul-Sep 2026, the same quarter CoreWeave reports tonight): 'Some third-party capacity deliveries we expected in Q1 were delayed'; MSFT capex+finance leases $45.2B vs $50.7B StreetAccount, with the shortfall pushed into FQ2 (>$50B) and CY ~ $170B. Microsoft is one of CoreWeave's largest customers, so the risk is CoreWeave Q3 revenue landing in the lower half of $3.45-3.60B (vs a $3.54B bar) and/or the Q4 implied revenue / exit run-rate $18.5-19.5B being trimmed; the offset is that the delayed spend was guided to land in Oct-Dec, i.e. CoreWeave's Q4.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Nov 2025 (baseline 2025-11-10): CoreWeave cut FY guide on a third-party data-center developer delay and fell -16.31%. On the MSFT comment itself CRWV fell 5.8% overnight on 2026-10-28.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock took -5.8% on the day and consensus revenue is still $3.54B, ABOVE the guide midpoint and up from $3.30B, so the estimate set has not been cut for a Microsoft-side delay. If the market had fully priced a CoreWeave-specific slip, Q3 revenue estimates would sit at or below the $3.525B midpoint. Microsoft did not name which neocloud was late.
findings.independence: IREN's fiscal Q1 2027 release (Nov 5-6) disclosed a delay to a revenue milestone tied to Microsoft infrastructure requirements, which suggests at least part of Microsoft's 'third-party delay' sits with IREN rather than CoreWeave (https://finviz.com/news/418223/iren-shares-surge-18-after-strong-ai-cloud-revenue-growth-and-better-than-expected-quarterly-results, page undated). Points the other way from this finding's sign.

findings.finding: Core Scientific (CoreWeave's largest colocation landlord; 100% of its colocation revenue is CoreWeave) reported on 2026-11-05 that billing capacity reached 485 MW at end-Q3 vs 395 MW at end-Q2 (+90 MW, +23% q/q), colocation revenue $215.4M, another 100 MW in commissioning — a counterparty confirming CoreWeave took delivery of substantial new capacity in the reported quarter, supporting the 1.5 GW -> >1.85 GW YE active-power path and Q4 revenue.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Capacity/active-power delivery was the line that broke in Nov 2025 (-16.31%, Denton delay at a Core Scientific site); when delivery and guidance held in Aug 2026 the stock rose +19.28%.
findings.why_not_priced: Released five days before the print by a different company in a crypto-miner news flow; CRWV fell ~9% the same day on the Microsoft/Nscale story and the election tape, so nothing in the CRWV price reacted to it. If priced, the Microsoft-delay read (finding 1) would not still be the dominant narrative going in.
findings.independence: Applied Digital Polaris Forge 1 (finding 3) is a separate landlord, separate document. https://blockspace.media/insight/core-scientific-colocation-revenue-rises/ (same CORZ release, same fact).

findings.finding: Other CoreWeave capacity counterparties on schedule: Applied Digital said on 2026-10-02 the second phase of Building 2 at Polaris Forge 1 (fully leased to CoreWeave, ~250 MW live of 400 MW, ~$11B lease) reached Ready for Service; CoreWeave said on 2026-10-27 most of the planned 22.5 MW at Copenhagen DEN01 is live; Galaxy's Helios Phase I (133 MW) was fully handed over by June and held flat through Q3 with Phase II still targeted Q2 2027 (no slip).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Same line as finding 2: delivery slips cost -16.31% (Nov 2025); delivery on plan with a raise bought +19.28% (Aug 2026).
findings.why_not_priced: Landlord milestones are small individually and sit in other companies' news flow; the CRWV tape since Oct 6 has traded financing and macro, not deliveries. Corroborative rather than decisive.
findings.independence: DEN01 and Galaxy facts from https://www.boerse-express.com/news/articles/coreweave-aktie-quartalszahlen-am-10-november-958301 (2026-11-02) and https://blockspace.media/insight/galaxy-helios-reports-quarterly-ebitda/ ; different documents from finding 2.

findings.finding: Financing cost is the debated line going in: debt $51.6B at 2026-06-30 (vs $14.6B a year earlier), 9.625% 2032 notes below 80c (~15% yield; a 2031 bond touched 15.76%) mid-October, Q3 interest guide $860-940M against Q3 adj. OI guide $200-260M, Morgan Stanley (downgrade to Hold, PT $70, 2026-10-23) estimating $24-37B of additional debt need. The print will update capex ($35-39B, raised once already after Q2 overshot) and the funding plan; the money buys capacity against $104B backlog plus >$25B signed early in Q3, corroborated by landlord deliveries (findings 2-3), so it is a ramp being funded, but at a markedly higher marginal cost of capital.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Capex raise in Aug 2026 came with a revenue/OI raise and the stock rose +19.28%; the Oct 14 bond selloff alone took the stock -15.5% in a day and -23.9% in a week.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the -38.6% 20-day drawdown and 15% bond yields ARE this concern. What is not priced is the Q4/2027 capex number and any new financing disclosed with the print; if the market expected no further capex raise, the put skew would not be +14 points.
findings.independence: Trefis, 2026-11-05 (debt 193% of market cap, FCF -$13.66B TTM): https://www.trefis.com/stock/crwv/articles/622866/what-is-driving-the-fall-in-coreweave-stock/2026-11-05 ; MS/UBS/Goldman actions: https://www.boerse-express.com/news/articles/coreweave-aktie-quartalszahlen-am-10-november-958301 . Goldman upgraded to Buy in the same window, pointing the other way.

findings.finding: Equity supply: on 2026-09-17 CoreWeave set up an at-the-market program for up to 35M Class A shares (~$2.9B at the then price) alongside a $3B+ convertible (reported up to $3.7-4.2B, 2.875% due 2033); the 10-Q filed with or after the print will show how much of the ATM was sold during Q3 at prices that have since fallen ~50%, and diluted share count was already +13% y/y.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The ATM + convert announcement day (2026-09-17) the stock fell more than 5%.
findings.why_not_priced: The program is public; the amount sold is not. At ~$48 the full 35M shares would raise only ~$1.7B, so remaining ATM capacity is a weak lever and the size is small.

findings.finding: Positioning into the print is washed out: 21.25% of float short (69.8M shares, Nasdaq 2026-10-15 settlement), stock -38.6% over 20 sessions and -65% from its 52-week high, 1.4-1.7x forward sales vs a ~3.6-3.9x average, with recent legs driven by macro rather than company news (-9.9% on 2026-11-04 on the midterm result, -9% on 2026-11-05 on Microsoft declining Nscale's Texas option). The last time the company held guidance and raised (Aug 2026) the stock rose +19.28%; a reaffirmed FY and exit run-rate against this short base is a squeeze mechanism inside the window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: +19.28% (Aug 2026, beat-and-raise into a stock 40%+ off its high) vs -11.40, -18.51, -16.31 on the three prints before.
findings.why_not_priced: The put skew (+14.29) and the 16% implied move say the market is paying for downside, not for a squeeze; if a squeeze were priced, call wings would be bid and skew flat. Days to cover is only ~1, which is why this is sized moderately.
findings.independence: Drawdown causes: https://www.trefis.com/stock/crwv/articles/622866/what-is-driving-the-fall-in-coreweave-stock/2026-11-05 (election day -9.9%) and https://www.tikr.com/blog/coreweave-sinks-9-as-microsoft-rejects-nscales-texas-expansion-the-first-person-whos-going-to-suffer (2026-11-05). Fintel is a different source from the price history.

findings.finding: Demand-signal risk on new bookings: the FT reported (2026-11-05) Microsoft declined an option to more than double its lease at Nscale's Texas site, Microsoft's second walk-away from Nscale in 2026; CRWV fell 9% that day although its $104.2B backlog is not affected. Any soft commentary tonight on Microsoft renewals or new hyperscaler bookings would land on that narrative.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Bookings were the positive in Aug 2026 (Meta +$21B, Anthropic, Jane Street $6B; +19.28%).
findings.why_not_priced: Already traded -9% on it; it is a peer/proxy item, not a CoreWeave contract change. Filed small.
findings.independence: Shares Microsoft as the entity with finding 1 but a different fact (lease option at a peer vs delivery timing); none independent beyond that.

findings.finding: The revenue bar has moved up to $3.54B, above the $3.525B guide midpoint and up from ~$3.30B when guided, while CoreWeave's revenue beats have been thin (Q2 $2.58B vs $2.56B, +0.8%); a beat on the top line is likely small, and the EPS bar is disputed (-$1.17 Zacks/EW, -$1.49 Benzinga, whisper -$1.00).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The company has beaten revenue every quarter and the stock still fell on three of the last four prints; the quarter itself has not paid, guidance has.
findings.why_not_priced: This is the bar itself, so it is priced by definition; filed so the judges see that consensus sits in the top half of the guide.

findings.finding: Insider selling has gone quiet into the print: eight Form 4s from 2026-10-07 to 2026-11-06 showed four executives selling ~$6.08M in total, mostly tax-on-vest and 10b5-1 (e.g. CRO Jonathan Jones ~$2.94M on Oct 12-13), against ~$2.2B of open-market insider sales over the prior 12 months.
findings.why_not_priced: Neither a buying signal nor a supply overhang inside the window; filed for completeness.
findings.independence: CEO had sold nearly $1B since IPO per filings (https://www.thestar.com.my/tech/tech-news/2026/10/17/coreweave039s-ceo-sold-nearly-1-billion-of-stock-since-ipo-filings-show, 2026-10-17).

baseline_tension: The negatives I found (Microsoft delivery slip, financing cost, Nscale) agree with the +14 put skew and the 38.6% drawdown and are therefore largely priced; the counterparty delivery data and a 21%-of-float short cut against the skew, so the net is a near-coin-flip on a large absolute move.
lessons_applied: Lesson 4 (financing is a question): the money funds capacity against $104B+$25B backlog corroborated by landlord deliveries, so the financing finding went -1.0 -> -0.5 and the ATM finding -0.5 -> -0.2.
Lesson 7 (crowded short, 21% of float): negatives shrunk once - Microsoft delay -1.5 -> -1.2; p_up moved 48 -> 49.
Lesson 5 (proxy smaller): Microsoft/Nscale peer lease item -0.5 -> -0.3.
Lesson 1 (verified fact is not a reaction; beats sold 3 of last 4): Core Scientific delivery finding +1.0 -> +0.7, Applied Digital/landlord finding +0.5 -> +0.4.

Lessons 6 and 8 left sizes standing: revenue bar is sourced to the guide plus agreeing estimates (EPS bar disputed, noted), Nebius kept in outside_window; coverage is heavy so no thin-coverage upsizing.
